company.name: Bellwether Coffee
company.description: Bellwether Coffee gives cafés and coffee businesses everything they need to roast, brand, and sell great coffee, powered by the world's only electric, ventless, and automatic commercial coffee roaster.

product.name: Bellwether Shop Roaster
product.award: Specialty Coffee Association — Best New Product 2024
product.summary: The world's only electric, ventless, and automatic commercial coffee roaster. Roast fresh in-house with no gas line, no exhaust venting, and no construction.

specs.roastsPerHour: 3–4 standard; up to 13 with the Continuous Roasting upgrade
specs.weeklyCapacity: up to 400 lbs/week with the Continuous Roasting upgrade and autoloader
specs.dailyThroughput: 15–20 kg (33–44 lb) standard; 80+ kg (176+ lb) with the autoloader
specs.ventless: Coffee roasts in an enclosed chamber; an internal afterburner neutralizes smoke and VOCs, so nothing vents outside the building.

pricing.note: Hardware pricing; financing available. The bundle is the Shop Roaster + Continuous Roasting Kit at a discount.

program.summary: Bellwether is a complete coffee business program, not just hardware.
includes: Bellwether Shop Roaster — electric, ventless, automatic
Green Coffee Marketplace — traceable, ethically sourced green coffee with roast profiles ready to go
Coffee team support — help choosing coffees and building a menu
Packaging & retail program — sell your own branded bags

differentiators: Ventless — operates with no exhaust infrastructure, so it fits locations gas roasters cannot (malls, historic buildings, office cafés).
All-electric — no gas lines; up to 87% lower carbon footprint than gas roasters.
Fully automatic — no roasting experience required; any staff member can operate it.
Complete coffee business program — marketplace, coffee team, packaging, and service, not just a machine.
Multi-location consistency — synced roast profiles produce identical coffee across every location.
